title: Chladni — Cymatics Studio
description: A standing-wave sand plate and a ripple tank in one — watch grains self-organize into nodal patterns or paint interfering waves.
concept: Explore cymatics two ways: Sand Plate mode simulates thousands of grains migrating away from vibration antinodes toward the nodal lines of a two-dimensional standing wave (the classic Chladni-plate effect), driven by an analytic eigenmode formula you tune live. Ripple Tank mode lets you tap to drop oscillating wave sources and watch real interference patterns bloom across the plate. Auto-morph slowly drifts the wave modes for a hypnotic evolving pattern, and every configuration can be exported as a PNG, saved as a named local preset, or shared as a URL.
features: Two simulation modes: physically-inspired sand-grain Chladni plate vs. multi-source ripple-tank wave interference
Live-tunable wave mode numbers (m,n), grain count, and restlessness, plus 8 classic mode presets and a randomizer
Auto-morph mode that continuously drifts between standing-wave patterns
Tap-to-poke (sand) / tap-to-drop-source (ripple) interaction on the plate itself, mouse and touch alike
5 color palettes, PNG export, named local preset gallery, and shareable URL-hash links that restore the exact pattern
tech: Analytic Chladni eigenmode field with closed-form gradient
Coarse-grid interference field upscaled via drawImage smoothing

interaction.mouse: Tap/click the plate to poke sand grains or drop a ripple source, depending on mode
interaction.click: Use the panel to switch modes, tune sliders, pick a classic preset or palette, export, save or share
interaction.touch: Same tap-to-interact gesture works on the plate; panel collapses behind a gear button on small screens
